purpose: Assets reservados para uso futuro; não adicionam NPCs nem carregam imagens no jogo atual.
style: Interpretação em pixel art para o jogo, baseada nos retratos consultados e no estilo dos sprites existentes.

assets.name: David Canabarro
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent production animation sprite atlas for Bodega do Sadi, a warm rural Brazilian top-down 3/4 RPG. Create a NEW character in polished hand-painted PIXEL ART: crisp dark outlines, chunky readable pixel clusters, restrained earthy colors, compact stylized adult proportions, head about one-quarter of height, visible articulated legs and boots. Exactly TWELVE isolated full-body poses in FOUR columns and THREE rows. Every cell must have a generous empty gutter: each figure occupies only the central 65% of the cell width and 78% of its height, NEVER crosses cell borders, same body scale and identical costume throughout. Real transparent alpha PNG, no ground shadow or scenery. Row 1 facing FRONT: 0 standing, 1 left-foot forward walking, 2 right-foot forward walking, 3 passing/recovery stride. Row 2 facing RIGHT: 4 side standing, 5 long left-leg forward stride with opposite arm forward, 6 clearly opposite right-leg forward stride, 7 bent-knee passing stride. Row 3: 8 BACK standing, 9 BACK left-foot forward, 10 BACK right-foot forward, 11 character-specific gesture in three-quarter view facing right. Walking feet must clearly swap positions, never duplicate the same stride. Keep both hands and both feet visible when anatomically appropriate. NO text, labels, grid lines, borders, watermarks, oversized heads, detached limbs or additional characters. Entire figure inside each cell with transparent padding above hair and below boots. Subject: David Canabarro, mature 19th-century southern Brazilian military figure, inspired by his archival portrait. Weathered light olive complexion, serious long oval face, deep dark eyes beneath straight thick eyebrows, medium-length straight dark brown hair with GRAY at the temples, parted at the center/high side and curling outward above the ears, broad connected salt-and-pepper beard and a substantial dark mustache. No hat; his distinctive parted hair and beard remain visible. Costume adapted to the game's Farroupilha characters: worn dark charcoal-blue officer coat with modest brass buttons, burgundy-red stand collar and cuffs, small flat gold shoulder tabs (NOT giant epaulettes), ivory shirt, brown leather waist belt, brown loose riding trousers and calf-high worn black boots. No cape, poncho, glowing ghost effects or weapons in hands. Compact grounded adult silhouette, not a child, distinguish from Bento's broad hat and short black beard. Final frame 11: a firm open-hand gesture directing troops, other hand relaxed at waist. Keep face, hair, trim and proportions identical in all twelve frames.
